Introduction: Vindaloo (also known as vindalho) is an Indian curry dish popular in the region of Goa, the surrounding Konkan, and many other parts of India. The cuisine also includes a variation of the dish. However, it is known globally in its Anglo-Indian form as a staple of curry house and Indian restaurant menus, often regarded as a fiery, spicy dish, even though it is not necessarily the spiciest dish available.

Chicken Vindaloo Wiki

Want to know more about Goan Cuisine

Ingredients

  • Chicken - 750 g(cut into chunks, Increase or decrease quantity as per your requirement)
  • Potatoes - 1 or 2 (cut into big chunks) - optional
  • Coconut milk - 1 cup
  • Salt - as needed
  • Oil - 1 tbsp (to fry onions)
  • Oil - 3-4 tbsp to fry marinated chicken

**************** To Grind ***************

  • Fried Onions - 1 cup (one big or medium sized chopped onion which we will fry in the beginning)
  • Vinegar - 1 or 2 tsp
  • Ginger Garlic paste -1-2 tbsp
  • Dry red Chillies - 5-8 (or use chilly powder as needed)
  • Mustard seeds - 1/2 tsp
  • Cumin seeds - 1/2 tsp
  • Fenugreek seeds - 1/4 tsp
  • Coriander seeds - 1/2 tsp
  • Cinnamon stick - 1 small piece
  • Cloves - 3

Steps

  • Add one tablespoon oil to a pan to fry onions.
  • Now add finely chopped onions and chopped chillies to the pan.
  • When onions become translucent or slight orange then add ginger garlic paste and fry for 30 s to 50 s.
  • When fried take out the fried onions, we will grind it.
  • Now take all the ingredients mentioned in "To marinate" and add them in a grinder.
  • Add very little water and grind the mixture into a smooth paste.
  • After grinding take the paste and put it into washed and pat dried chicken pieces.
  • Spread and mix the paste well but gently over the chicken pieces.
  • put it to marinate for AT LEAST 30 minutes.
  • After marination, take some oil in a pan/wok and allow it to heat till the smoking point.
  • Once heated add marinated chicken pieces and fry chicken over medium high heat for 3-5 minutes.
  • Now add potatoes pieces.
  • Sprinkle salt, add coconut milk and little water mix them well.
  • Now cover the chicken and let it cook for 12-18 minutes on low medium flame. Keep stir in between couple of times if necessary.
  • After 12-18 minutes remove top cover and let it simmer for 2-3 minutes. Keep stirring few times.
  • Your dish Chicken Vindaloo is ready.
  • Now serve it in a serving bowl, garnish it with fresh coriander and serve hot with Roti(Indian bread) or rice
